items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So we stayed in Philadelphia with this lady for about two and a half years

ctx.x: -- that was taking you to New York?

Yeah, uh-huh. See now, as we were traveling, you see, and we got -- finally got to Philadelphia, he stopped at a place -- Miss Edwina Sutton's place down in Philadelphia somewhere on -- think it was North Philadelphia where she was. And she had a big picture of Mr. Buddy Bradley, you know, because her husband was in import and export, you see. He traveled on the seas, you see, and he

was a fan of Buddy Bradley's, you know, and he liked Buddy Bradley, and he had this picture; it was like a portrait; it was in the living room, and she liked us. So Mr. Robey had her to -- (inaudible) like as a guardian. She would look after us children while he would -- he'd like go -- he went over to New York with Obi Walker somewhere, you know, and he got him some fights or something, you know.
